meaning: Source/document review attestations, not proof of semantic correctness or issue completion.

agents.review_note: Reviewed runtime tool policy and database changes; campaign receipts remain outside agent context, no new capability or instruction exposure.

auth.review_note: Reviewed current browser actor hash derived from session sub, CSRF and ownership checks; existing authentication/role flows unchanged.

commerce.review_note: Reviewed shared persistence and verified order/GST invariants; new family operations confined to campaign_bookings, no shop payment/order/refund/invoice mutation.

content.review_note: Reviewed published authored revision and immutable file grants; explicit replacement requires same revision/amount/mode/files, preserves old receipts and updated authored page/storage documentation.

foundation.review_note: Reviewed optional JSON metadata in existing MySQL collection and root-first transaction locking; no new table, dependency or cross-client exposure. Updated storage documentation.

google-tags.review_note: Reviewed independent GST Settings form and help alongside Google tags guidance; existing integration fields and tag handling are unchanged.

http-errors.review_note: Reviewed status failure and ambiguous transport recovery: failed reads clear terminal proof; invalid CSRF/confirmation cannot start provider work; errors reveal no provider bodies.

interface.review_note: Reviewed Settings selector, invoice register scroll layout and generated schema, verified actual desktop/375px form and report browser regression.

mail.review_note: Reviewed shared database operations and email workflow; campaign receipt remains independent of order confirmation and mail queue; no new messages or replay.

mcp-clients.review_note: Reconciled shared CLI guide against current main; public and owner STDIO grant behavior unchanged, no new MCP tool.

media.review_note: Reviewed the owner UI skill changes against authenticated media navigation, route declarations, and Media Library behavior. Reconciled on da0981d; retained the existing source changes and regenerated exact route artifacts.

operator-help.review_note: Reviewed owner guides and authored page payment configuration; replacement is a customer receipt action, not a new owner form or admin mutation.

public-mcp.review_note: Reviewed existing anonymous shop checkout and public enquiry boundaries; authored campaign receipt action remains browser and actor bound, no MCP declarations or shop checkout behavior changed.

remote-commerce.review_note: Reviewed exact provider terminal and order-payment contracts, durable family reservation, recheck generations, immutable captures and duplicate/late settlement; updated remote commerce contract.

sales-channels.review_note: Reviewed merchant feed and approved read-only CLI operations; portable validation uses synthetic fixtures only, no channel publishing.

workflow.review_note: Reconciled campaign recovery baseline with shared PHP release gate, all standalone portable tests retained, hosted browser/SDK/MySQL lanes unchanged.
